items.title: Barry bags first Everton hat-trick as they breeze past Preston
items.description: Highlights of the Carabao Cup second round match between Preston North End and Everton.

items.title: Savio scores on debut as Spurs ease into Carabao Cup third round
items.description: Highlights of the Carabao Cup match between Tottenham Hotspur and Charlton Athletic.

items.title: Barnes scores two as Newcastle survive scare against West Brom
items.description: Highlights from the Carabao Cup match between Newcastle United and West Brom.

items.title: Savio steals show on debut as Spurs thrash Charlton
items.description: Savio grabbed a goal and assist on a dream debut as Tottenham thrashed Charlton to progress into the third round of the Carabao Cup.

items.title: Barry hat-trick helps Everton saunter past Preston
items.description: Thierno Barry scored three goals and set up the other as Everton sauntered into the third round of the Carabao Cup by way of a 4-0 win over Preston at Deepdale.

items.title: 'Excellent goal!' - Savio scores 11 minutes into Spurs debut!
items.description: Savio scores 11 minutes into his Spurs debut against Charlton.

items.title: Barnes double fires Newcastle past West Brom
items.description: Harvey Barnes struck twice for Newcastle as they survived a scare against West Brom to win 3-2 and reach the third round of the Carabao Cup.

items.title: Bradford beat Burnley on pens to reach third round
items.description: Bradford extended Burnley's uncomfortable start to the season with a 4-2 penalty shoot-out win after their second-round Carabao Cup tie had finished goalless at Valley Parade.

items.title: Viking through to the Champions League for first time with victory over Dinamo Zagreb
items.description: Viking shock Dinamo Zagreb with a three one win to book there place in the Champions League.

items.title: Liverpool to face Tottenham in EFL Cup third round
items.description: Liverpool face Tottenham in the third round of the EFL Cup, Manchester United play Brighton and Manchester City draw Norwich.

items.title: Fenerbahce back in the Champions League after 18 years
items.description: Goals from Vedat Muriqi and Archie Brown prove to be enough for Fenerbahce to get past Olympique Lyonnais and in to the league stage of the Champions League

items.title: Al-Hilal closing in on Watkins - Thursday's gossip
items.description: Al-Hilal close in on a £50m deal for Ollie Watkins, Chelsea line up Bournemouth's Alex Scott, Sunderland make a loan offer for Jack Grealish, plus more.
